body.p: Reusable content blocks shared by two or more topics. Pull them with conref. ID prefix: reuse-. Add a block here only when it is reused; single-use notes stay inline.
A working copy is loaded in the Git Staging view. If it is not, clone, create, or open one first.
body.note: Avoid amending, rebasing, or resetting commits you have already pushed. These operations rewrite history, which disrupts anyone who has already pulled those commits.
body.p: If the push is rejected because your local branch is behind the remote, pull the remote changes first, then push again.
